interface.signature: minStepToReachTarget(knightPos: List[int], targetPos: List[int], N: int) -> int

preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard N must be between 1 and 1000.
The initial position of the Knight must be within the bounds of the chessboard.
The target position must be within the bounds of the chessboard.

postconditions.description: The function returns the minimum number of steps required to reach the target position or -1 if it is not possible.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if knightPos == targetPos else return_value > 0
postconditions.description: If the Knight is already at the target position, the function returns 0; otherwise, it returns a positive number of steps.
